name: phinite-agents
description: Connect Claude to Phinite agents — list and invoke published agents, and create new agent flows.

PHINITE_API_KEY.label: Phinite API Key
PHINITE_API_KEY.description: Your Phinite API key. Required for the registry endpoint and flow creation. Find it in the Phinite dashboard.

PHINITE_WORKSPACE_ID.label: Workspace ID
PHINITE_WORKSPACE_ID.description: Your Phinite workspace ID. Required to list and invoke agents. Find it in the Phinite dashboard URL.

PHINITE_APP_BASE_URL.label: App API base URL
PHINITE_APP_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Phinite REST API. Override only for staging/local backends.

PHINITE_A2A_BASE_URL.label: A2A endpoint base URL
PHINITE_A2A_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Phinite A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server. Override only for staging/local backends.
